notes.about: Punjabi in Gurmukhi, a script the engine has no rules of its own for: this file is all it knows. Sources: data/manifests/pawiki.json, pawikisource.json, aksharantar-pan.json.
notes.notWord: The digits ੦-੯, ek onkar ੴ (a symbol, not a word) and the abbreviation sign ੶.
notes.firstLetter: Independent vowels, consonants, the nukta letters (U+0A59-0A5E; ਖ਼ ਗ਼ ਜ਼ ਫ਼ are their consonant + nukta after NFC, ੜ is its own letter), and the vowel bearers ੲ ੳ. Never a sign, the bindi, tippi or addak.
notes.signs: Vowel signs, the virama (written only for the subscript ੍ਰ ੍ਹ ੍ਵ ੍ਯ), udaat and yakash must follow a consonant. The bindi ਂ, tippi ੰ, adak bindi ਁ and visarga ਃ are left out: they follow independent vowels as well (ਉਂ, ਅੰਦਰ). So is the addak ੱ, which doubles the consonant after it and may follow an independent vowel (ਉੱਤੇ, ਉੱਪਰ).
notes.replace: Independent vowels typed as their bearer (ਅ ੲ ੳ) plus a vowel sign are mended to the letter Unicode has for them (ੲਿ is ਇ, ੳੁ is ਉ); ੲ and ੳ alone stay as they are. ਲ਼ and ਸ਼ are ਲ and ਸ + nukta after NFC (composition exclusions), like ਖ਼ ਗ਼ ਜ਼ ਫ਼. Every ZWJ and ZWNJ is dropped (no joiners field): the text has fewer than 100 of each.
notes.phraseBreaks: Punjabi ends a sentence with the danda । (U+0964); ॥ ends verse.
